title: 第二十七章 一招定胜负第二十八章 战斗结束
lines: 第二十七章一招定胜负
烟尘之中，千鸟齐鸣，浓烟之中隐隐有着蓝色的电光闪过，白牙心中凝重了起来，“这少年怎会有如此华丽的忍术，之前的无印忍术亦是，如今又出现了新的神秘的忍术。”
与一个看似十四五岁的少年战到这个地步，白牙也没有想到，眉头微皱，思索起来。
“难道他真的是赏金猎人？但赏金猎人多为浪忍和叛忍，其自身拥有的忍术资源几乎为零，更别提掌握这强大的忍术了，少数的强大赏金猎人，自己当会知晓，怎会毫无头绪？”
“出全力杀了他？”白牙心想，但随即轻轻摇了摇头，没有听说过这号赏金猎人，同理，白牙也未听过哪个忍村有这样的青年才俊，白牙自不能妄动杀机。
“打败他再说，若被逼无奈，使出了全力失手杀了他，便是他的命数了。”白牙打定了注意，虽然思绪颇多，但时间也就过去了五六秒钟，同时，夜天云的忍术也准备完成。
“千鸟！”夜天云高喊出这个忍术的名字，顿时蓝白色的电光大盛，将烟尘驱散，露出了夜天云的身影。
夜天云此时颇为狼狈，额头、嘴角皆受伤流血，黑色的风衣裂了几个口子，满是灰尘，但夜天云面色坚毅，眼神凌厉，左手成虎爪电光四射，右手持墨刀银刃若霜，倒也威风凛凛。
事实上夜天云别无他法，近战时鲜有机会结印，而螺旋丸两度被破，远距离的忍术则难以对抗白牙凌冽雄浑的刀势，只有这穿刺力和爆发性速度具为上佳的千鸟才可能造成实质性伤害。
夜天云凝视着远处的木叶白牙，腰身一弯，双膝委屈，猛的弹了出去，在雷属性查克拉的刺激下，小腿的肌肉变得发达异常，加上使用了鬼步的运力方式，夜天云的速度已快过了普通的瞬身术，非一般上忍所能及。
“刺啦啦”，左手下垂，四散的狂暴雷属性查克拉将所过之处拖拽出一道深约一尺的深沟，夜天云朝着白牙的方向狂奔。
“借助冲刺力和穿刺力造成单一点的毁灭性打击，不过攻击路径太单一了，而且，行进的速度太快，恐怕难以捕捉敌人的位置。”白牙一眼就洞穿了千鸟的优劣点。
白牙神色如常，打不中的忍术，即便在强，也毫无意义。
“站着不动了，是要等到临近后在躲开么？”看着不动如山的白牙，夜天云心道。”不过，白牙也有失算的时候。”夜天云拥有魂知，自不必为瞄准成功与否而担忧，但他却别有想法。
夜天云仍旧速度不减，反而全力加速，向白牙直冲过去。
转瞬间两人相距不过一丈，按照夜天云的速度，两三步后手中的千鸟便能击中对方。
“他难道有别的想法？”白牙心中十分奇怪，凭借之前的交手，他不认为夜天云会看不穿他的战术。
转眼间，夜天云来到了白牙的身前，在昏暗的林中，千鸟迸发出的电芒如雷电般闪耀夺目，刺耳的声响震的两人的耳鼓微微生疼。
白牙盯着电芒后的手腕，双膝委曲，时刻准备发力，手中的短刀向后微微后撤，留出一丝加速的空间，只待躲过了夜天云的攻击，便立刻反客为主，实行反击。
此时，千鸟已几乎接触到了白牙的胸口。
但，夜天云的左手猛然垂下，目标竟不是自己的胸口，而是脚下的地面。
“咔嚓。”一声脆响，千鸟撞击到地面中，将两人脚下的地面打的七零八落，夜天云自手指到手肘全部没入土中。纷飞的沙石，浓浓的烟尘将两人裹在一起。
“为什么？”白牙心中疑惑，但间不容发，纵身后跃，离开了烟尘覆盖的区域，刚站定身形，夜天云那墨色的太刀尾随而至，刺向了白牙的面部。
白牙想用刀挡住，不料刀锋突然变得飘忽不定，夜天云好似手腕一松，刀锋微微下垂了两寸，正好避开了白牙短刀的封锁路径，指向了他的咽喉要害。
“幻阴。”一声清吟，见到白牙后退了一步，避开了刺向咽喉的利刃，夜天云突然使用了鬼闪瞬到白牙的身侧，刀锋竟指向白牙的腰眼。
而当白牙准备用短刀挡住之时，夜天云的太刀却侧过了白牙的短刀，刀锋飘渺无规律，上移了几寸指向了肋下。
“古怪！”白牙被各种诡异的攻击弄的心神微乱，夜天云的攻击看似飘忽不定，实则刚柔并济，看似杂乱无章，但又似蕴藏着规律。
飘渺不定，刀虽心动，这便是幻阴。
几招过后，夜天云的刀锋轨迹始终难以捉摸，白牙猛的爆发了刀势。
“旗木流奥义，獠牙！”白牙大喝一声，用力向夜天云劈去，想要用刀势将夜天云刀锋的轨迹逼出来。
不料，夜天云运用鬼闪，躲过了白牙施展的招式，然后太刀翻舞，刺向了白牙的后心。
后背处微微发凉，寒意侵心，白牙转身回挡，却又扑了个空，夜天云的太刀又从短刀的下方划过，不与之相拼，而是转而攻向他处。
第二十七章一招定胜负
两人就这样过了十几招，即便是白牙，心中也有些气恼，近战十几招，双方兵器却未相交过一次，简直闻所未闻。

Chapter 27 One move determines victory or defeat
In the smoke, thousands of birds chirped, and blue lightning flashed faintly in the thick smoke. White Ya's heart became solemn, "How can this young man have such a gorgeous ninjutsu? The same is true for the previous Muji ninjutsu, and now a new mysterious ninjutsu has appeared."
White Fang did not expect that he would fight to this extent with a boy who looked to be fourteen or fifteen years old. He frowned slightly and began to think.
"Is he really a bounty hunter? But most of the bounty hunters are Lang Ninja and Rennin Ninja. Their own Ninjutsu resources are almost zero, let alone mastering this powerful Ninjutsu. There are a few powerful bounty hunters who should know about it. How can they have no clue?"
"Kill him with all your strength?" White Fang thought, but then he shook his head slightly. He had never heard of this bounty hunter. Similarly, White Fang had never heard of any ninja village with such a young talent. White Fang could not act rashly with murderous intentions.
"After defeating him, if he is forced to have no choice but to use all his strength and accidentally kill him, it will be his fate." Bai Ya fixed his attention. Although he had many thoughts, only five or six seconds had passed. At the same time, Ye Tianyun's ninjutsu was also ready to be completed.
"Chidori!" Ye Tianyun shouted the name of this ninjutsu, and suddenly the blue and white lightning flashed, scattering the smoke and dust, revealing Ye Tianyun's figure.
Ye Tianyun was quite embarrassed at this time. His forehead and corners of his mouth were injured and bleeding. His black windbreaker had several cracks and was covered with dust. However, Ye Tianyun had a resolute look on his face and sharp eyes. His left hand was like a tiger's claw and flashed with lightning. His right hand held a black ink knife with a silver blade like frost, which made him look majestic.
In fact, Ye Tianyun had no other choice. There were few opportunities to form seals in close combat, and the Rasengan was broken twice. Long-range ninjutsu was difficult to resist White Fang's powerful sword power. Only Chidori, with its excellent piercing power and explosive speed, could cause substantial damage.
Ye Tianyun stared at the White Fang of Konoha in the distance. He bent his waist, bent his knees, and jumped out violently. Under the stimulation of the thunder attribute chakra, the muscles of his calves became abnormally developed. Coupled with the use of the ghost step to transport power, Ye Tianyun's speed was faster than the ordinary teleportation technique, and beyond the reach of ordinary jounin.
"Stab la la", his left hand dropped, and the scattered violent thunder-attribute chakra dragged out a deep trench about a foot deep wherever it passed. Ye Tianyun ran wildly in the direction of Bai Ya.
"Use the power of sprinting and piercing to cause a single point of devastating blow, but the attack path is too single, and the speed of travel is too fast, it may be difficult to capture the enemy's position." White Fang understood the advantages and disadvantages of Chidori at a glance.
White Fang's expression was as usual, and the ninjutsu that could not hit him, even if it was strong, was meaningless.
"Standing still, do you want to wait until it gets closer and then run away?" Ye Tianyun thought to himself as he looked at White Fang who was as motionless as a mountain. "However, White Fang sometimes makes miscalculations." Ye Tianyun has soul knowledge, so he doesn't have to worry about whether his aim is successful, but he has other ideas.
Ye Tianyun still did not slow down, but accelerated with all his strength, rushing towards White Fang.
In an instant, the two of them were only one foot apart. According to Ye Tianyun's speed, the Chidori in his hand would be able to hit each other in two or three steps.
"Does he have other ideas?" Bai Ya felt very strange. Based on the previous fights, he didn't think Ye Tianyun would not be able to see through his tactics.
In the blink of an eye, Ye Tianyun arrived in front of Bai Ya. In the dim forest, the lightning bursts from the thousands of birds shone as brightly as thunder, and the harsh sound made the eardrums of the two people hurt slightly.
White Teeth stared at the wrist behind the electric light, his knees bent, always ready to use force. The short knife in his hand moved back slightly, leaving a little room for acceleration. As soon as he escaped Ye Tianyun's attack, he immediately turned his back and launched a counterattack.
At this time, Chidori was almost touching White Fang's chest.
However, Ye Tianyun's left hand suddenly dropped, and the target was not his chest, but the ground under his feet.
"Crack." With a crisp sound, the Chidori hit the ground, shattering the ground beneath their feet. Ye Tianyun's entire body from his fingers to his elbows was buried in the soil. Flying sand and stones, and thick smoke and dust wrapped the two together.
"Why?" Bai Ya was confused, but he didn't have time to say anything. He jumped back and left the area covered with smoke. Just as he stood still, Ye Tianyun's dark sword followed and stabbed Bai Ya in the face.
White Fang wanted to block it with his knife, but unexpectedly the blade suddenly became erratic. Ye Tianyun seemed to loosen his wrist, and the blade dropped slightly by two inches, just in time to avoid the blocked path of White Fang's short knife and pointed at his throat.
"Huan Yin." With a clear chant, seeing White Ya take a step back to avoid the sharp blade piercing his throat, Ye Tianyun suddenly used Ghost Flash to reach White Ya's side, and the blade was actually pointed at White Ya's waist.
But when Bai Ya was about to block it with his dagger, Ye Tianyun's sword passed over White Ya's dagger. The blade was erratic and moved up a few inches to point under his ribs.
"Weird!" White Ya was slightly confused by all kinds of strange attacks. Ye Tianyun's attacks seemed erratic, but in fact they were both hard and soft. They seemed chaotic, but they seemed to contain rules.
Misty and uncertain, although the knife is moving in the heart, this is the phantom yin.
After several moves, Ye Tianyun's blade trajectory was still elusive, and White Fang violently unleashed his sword power.
"The secret of Hatake-ryu, fangs!" White Fang shouted loudly and slashed at Ye Tianyun with all his strength, trying to force out the trajectory of Ye Tianyun's blade with the force of the knife.
Unexpectedly, Ye Tianyun used ghost dodge to avoid White Ya's move, and then the sword danced and stabbed White Ya in the back of the heart.
A slight chill ran down his back, and a chill invaded his heart. White Fang turned around to block, but missed it again. Ye Tianyun's sword passed under the short sword again, and instead of fighting with it, he turned to attack elsewhere.
